label: SU: Scheduled Utilisation
definition: The single standard variant of Scheduled Utilisation: delivery times and prices fixed at trade, utilisation-only payment.

label: PR: Peak Reduction
definition: The single standard variant of Peak Reduction: peak delivery expectation, set at trade, utilisation-only payment.

label: OU-2: Operational Utilisation, 2 min
definition: Operational Utilisation with a maximum response time of 2 minutes from a real-time instruction.

label: OU-15: Operational Utilisation, 15 min
definition: Operational Utilisation with a maximum response time of 15 minutes from a real-time instruction.

label: SA OU-2: Scheduled Availability + OU, 2 min
definition: Fixed availability bought at trade; utilisation instructed in real time with a 2-minute maximum response. Added in June 2026 by change proposal FLX CP003.

label: SA OU-15: Scheduled Availability + OU, 15 min
definition: Fixed availability bought at trade; utilisation instructed in real time with a 15-minute maximum response. Added in June 2026 by change proposal FLX CP003.

label: SA OU-DA: Scheduled Availability + OU, day ahead
definition: Fixed availability bought at trade; utilisation confirmed operationally the day before delivery.

label: SA OU-WA: Scheduled Availability + OU, week ahead
definition: Fixed availability bought at trade; utilisation confirmed operationally the week before delivery. Added in June 2026 by change proposal FLX CP003, proposed by Northern Powergrid.

label: VA OU-2: Variable Availability + OU, 2 min
definition: Availability refined week ahead; utilisation instructed in real time with a 2-minute maximum response.

label: VA OU-15: Variable Availability + OU, 15 min
definition: Availability refined week ahead; utilisation instructed in real time with a 15-minute maximum response.

label: VA OU-DA: Variable Availability + OU, day ahead
definition: Availability refined week ahead; utilisation confirmed operationally the day before delivery.

label: VA OU-WA: Variable Availability + OU, week ahead
definition: Availability refined month ahead; utilisation confirmed operationally the week before delivery.

label: Sustain (legacy ENA product)
definition: Pre-2024 ENA product: a change in import or export over a period agreed in advance, to keep a network within its firm capacity; utilisation-only payment. Nearest current product: SU (inferred).

label: Secure (legacy ENA product)
definition: Pre-2024 ENA product: the DNO buys in advance the right to call on a change in import or export close to real time, depending on network conditions; availability and utilisation payments, with availability agreed at different horizons by different DNOs. Nearest current product: SA+OU or VA+OU (inferred; varies by DNO).

label: Dynamic (legacy ENA product)
definition: Pre-2024 ENA product: the DNO buys in advance the ability to call on a change in output after a network fault; mostly availability and utilisation payments. Nearest current product: SA+OU (inferred).

label: Restore (legacy ENA product)
definition: Pre-2024 ENA product: after a loss of supply, the provider stays off supply or reconnects with less demand or more generation, so that supplies can be restored faster; utilisation-only payment. Nearest current product: OU (inferred).

label: FlexAdvance (Northern Powergrid, non-standard)
definition: Northern Powergrid variant of Scheduled Utilisation that pays part of the forecast value upfront; offered subject to a derogation from the Flexibility Market Rules on standard products.
